integrity: The proof supplies a local bijection and a reproducible exact characteristic-polynomial and root-bound certificate. No external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem enumerates the pure, fully flipping portion of primitive two-cycles only; it does not enumerate partially stationary two-cycles, transients, or attraction basins. The all-size determinant factorization is an exact reproducible symbolic computation. Historical priority against unindexed sources and independent mathematical validation are unresolved.
title: A bounded-to-exponential transition in pure majority oscillations on cyclic clique strips
